acceptance.given: A Skill package contains zero or more supplied FAQ entries, each declaring or implying a local target.

oracle.expected: The package validator reports success only when every supplied FAQ entry resolves to an existing local target reachable from its declared stable error ID or decision branch.
forbidden: Any supplied FAQ entry resolves to a dead, missing, orphaned, or unknown local target.
A package with no FAQ entries is rejected solely because the FAQ set is empty.
oracle.observable: Validator result and diagnostics for the supplied FAQ entries during the FAQ reachability and local-target validation check.

acceptance.then: All supplied FAQ local targets resolve successfully and the validator accepts the FAQ reachability check.
acceptance.when: Run the Skill quality validator against the package's supplied FAQ entries and their local targets.

failure_intents.selector_intent: FAQ fixture with a supplied entry whose declared local target is missing or unreachable must be rejected by the FAQ reachability validator.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add FAQ reachability validation and executable coverage proving every supplied FAQ entry resolves to a local target while allowing an omitted FAQ set.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Remove the new FAQ reachability implementation and its tests; no persisted state or schema migration is involved.

slice_hint.state_transition: Supplied FAQ entries transition from potentially unresolved references to validator-checked, resolvable local targets; an absent FAQ remains valid.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted FAQ reachability test selector passes, including the negative unresolved-target case and the empty-FAQ case.
